title: Post-Apocalypse Texting
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm prepared for nuclear war' like checking your Instagram in a radioactive wasteland. This Pip-Boy case turns your phone into a survival tool—just don’t expect it to protect you from the actual fallout. Perfect for that friend who insists on LARPing as a vault dweller while waiting for their Uber.

title: Gaming on the Go
tagline: For when you need to play Fortnite during a funeral, this iPhone case doubles as a mini console, because priorities.

title: Saber Dueling for Introverts
tagline: For when you want to reenact Star Wars battles alone in your room, the Twistsaber is here. Because who needs human interaction when you can spin a glowing stick?

title: Throne Your Money Away
tagline: Because shredding to the Rains of Castamere on a $25,000 GoT-themed guitar is the perfect way to spend a Tuesday, alone in your basement.

title: Pong Under Glass
tagline: For the office that wants to host a meeting *and* a tournament. Just don’t blame us when someone tries to serve a document mid-rally. Perfect for the executive who’s tired of boring boardrooms and wants to add a little ‘ping’ to their presentations. Comes with a side of awkward silence when the CEO misses the ball.

title: The DualShock Throne
tagline: For when your gaming obsession has officially taken over your living room decor. This coffee table is perfect for the host who wants to serve drinks while subtly reminding guests that they'll never beat your high score in 'Crash Bandicoot'. Bonus: The analog sticks double as coasters, so you can finally put your Mountain Dew where it belongs.

title: Gamer’s Tactical Fanny Pack
tagline: For when your controller collection outgrows your pockets but you refuse to buy a backpack. Perfect for the LAN party enthusiast who needs to switch between a N64 and a Switch without missing a beat—or tripping over their own gear. Because nothing says 'serious gamer' like a chest rig full of nostalgia.

title: VR Hand Butler
tagline: Because you need help grasping virtual objects, literally. Imagine struggling to pick up a digital pencil, now solved with this glove.

title: Turtle Power in Your Basement
tagline: Because your garage band needs a break, install this vintage Ninja Turtles arcade machine. It's the perfect distraction from your neighbor's noise complaints.

title: Nerf Apocalypse Ensues
tagline: Because your D&D group needed more ways to settle disputes, these Warhammer Nerf guns bring a whole new level of 'friendly fire' to the table.

title: Joystick Mouse: For Overachievers
tagline: Because two hands aren't enough for your gaming addiction. Perfect for the FPS player who needs to strafe, aim, and order pizza simultaneously. The joysticks are so sensitive, you'll accidentally send your character into orbit while trying to scratch your nose. A must-have for those who've mastered the art of multitasking—like folding laundry while playing a ranked match.

title: Pocket-Sized Nostalgia Overload
tagline: For when your adult responsibilities are too much and you need to escape to a world where the hardest decision is whether to play Snake or Tetris. This tiny time machine fits in your pocket, so you can relive the glory days of 8-bit graphics during your soul-crushing commute. Just don't blame us if you start questioning all your life choices while waiting for your game to load.
